description: Memory routing test set, hand-labelled before any model saw it. Each turn lists the memory types it needs searched before the assistant answers: episodic (what happened), semantic (what is true), procedural (how to act). An empty list means no stored memory is needed. Twelve turns need two types at once.

stores.episodic: What happened: earlier conversations, past sessions, events and their summaries.
stores.semantic: What is true: facts about the user, the people and things in their life, their preferences, and stored documents.
stores.procedural: How to act: workflows, routines, standing instructions and skills the assistant has learned.
stores.none: Nothing stored is needed: small talk, general knowledge, or a task the message fully explains.
